title: BCC Ruling No. 17-07-1471 — permit response and written reasons timing
code_edition: Ontario Building Code 2012, O. Reg. 332/12, Division C; Building Code Act, 1992 (as cited)

facts.text: The applicant sought a permit to demolish an existing deck and build a replacement deck and sunroom at 217 Maki Avenue, Sudbury.
The dispute was whether the Chief Building Official issued or refused the permit, with written reasons, within the time limits in Division C Sentence 1.3.1.3.(1) and its table.
The record states the permit had not been issued and a written refusal with all reasons had not been provided by the stated deadline.
